name: mirage
text: Confirmed by tracing the code. All four go through the same BetRating formula in v1.0.64. The Vigilant scanner prices both Novig and Kalshi rows through one function, so they share it. The CNO scanner covers its Novig and Kalshi rows and its auto-bet, recheck and saved-bet records the same way. The only difference between scanners is the input, such as each bet's own books, edge and sport. I'm still on the star-sort problem. I can't see your screen, so which tab were you on when the sort buttons vanished: +EV, CNO or Kalshi? The +EV feed's Best EV / Soonest / Stars buttons are still in the code.
